4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Cast: Strahd's castle in Barovia, where the party broke up his wedding (S32); Rahadin and Helga Ruvak work there.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Coff: Henrik Van Der Voort's coffin shop in Vallaki; a teleport stone dropped the party there (S10).
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Deat: Haunted Durst house in the Village of Barovia, home of the ghost children Rose and Thorn; cleared in S1-S3.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Grey: Drowned deadwood in the Greenfall marsh over the Silent Ascendency's caves, where stolen magic is unmade; Izek waits there (S48).
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Lake: Barovian lake where the fisherman Bluto Krogarov and Arabelle, the Vistana girl he kidnapped, are found.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Old: Windmill in Barovia; home of Morgantha and her coven.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Ruin: Swamp ruins in Barovia where Baba Lysaga's creeping hut stood; explored S17-S23, the hut raided in S23.
Father Lucian's church in Vallaki; the party sheltered Ireena there (S5) and fought over St. Andral's bones (S6, S8).
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The: Temple where the Eternal Watch imprisoned Vecna; the party repaired the amber prison there (S19-S20). Exethanter and Kasimir remain.
Condemned Bruokdon charm-foundry the Silent Ascendency uses to move stolen magic items out of the city; raided in S45.
Bruokdon's magic academy under the Umbral Athenaeum Council; the party exposed the Ascendency's Bruokdon cell leader there (S44).
Martikov winery and Keepers of the Feather base; the party held it against the dark druids' siege (S28).
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Tser: Vistani camp of Madam Eva and Stanimir; the party met the Vistani there (S4).
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Tsol: Frozen mountain pass with a ruined fortress, Sangzor's lair; the party sheltered there and read the Tome of Strahd (S21).
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Van: Rictavio's tower near Vallaki; the party's sanctuary in S12-S15, where they held off a werewolf siege.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Wach: House Wachter's Vallaki seat, home of Stella Wachter and Majesto.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Were: Barovian lair of the werewolf pack, the Children of Mother Night.
4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Yest: Hill where the party broke the dark druids' ritual and felled the Gulthias Avatar, recovering the second gem (S29-S30).
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Adrian Martikov.md: Davian Martikov's son, a vintner at the Wizard of Wines and a member of the Keepers of the Feather.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Anastrasya Karelov: Strahd's surviving vampire-spawn bride; she fled the wedding-night battle, and Vecna's forces are courting her.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Anselm Corrow.md: Guildmaster of Duskferry's Ferrymen's Guild; not Ascendency, but ignores overpaying manifests and doesn't suspect his clerk Ostwin Reyes.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Arabelle (COS).md: Luvash's seven-year-old daughter, a Vistana kidnapped by Bluto Krogarov; unknowingly descended from Madam Eva.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Archmortician Vale: The Umbral Athenaeum's elf Councilor of Necromancy; a clinical scholar seeking immortality without corruption.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Archwarden Selvara: The Umbral Athenaeum's Councilor of Abjuration; a cautious warden who wants dangerous magic kept contained.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Arrigal (COS).md: Luvash's brother and co-leader of the Vallaki Vistani camp; a cunning assassin sworn to Strahd.
